load_evaluate_module: load a huggingface evaluate module by namespace and module slug
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for a loaded evaluate module
create_evaluate_metric_app: create a gradio app that lets users interactively test a huggingface evaluate metric
run_evaluate_module_ui: run the gradio UI for a huggingface evaluate module to test it interactively
build_evaluate_dashboard: build a gradio dashboard for a huggingface evaluate metric using evaluate.load and launch_gradio_widget
